deadline.value: No hard program closing deadline is published; the graduate school lists March 1 as the priority deadline for financial support consideration for international applicants.
deadline.quote: The deadlines listed are considered priority deadlines for all programs. Applicants requesting financial support are strongly encouraged to submit applications by this date. | March 1

gre_general.value: The Civil and Environmental Engineering PhD does not require the GRE.

gre_subject.value: The PhD does not require the GRE; the field has no subject test.

supervisor.value: The page says students work with a faculty advisor during the PhD, not whether one must agree before admission.

funding.value: Teaching and research assistantships are generally awarded to PhD applicants, according to the university FAQ; the department gives no separate figure.
funding.quote: Both Assistantships are generally awarded to Masters Thesis (MS-T) and Doctoral (PHD) level applicants.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the requirement, and a master's is helpful but not required.
entry_route.quote: A master’s degree is helpful but not required.

notes: Environmental Engineering and Science PhD is a separate program under environment.
name: Civil and Environmental Engineering (PhD)
